problem: The member shape is applied to every structural member linked from a ship and then requires every such member to be classified as bottom or side structure. I2.6.1 applies only to applicable local frames in bottom structures and transverse local frames in side structures, so this broad scope can impose the rule on non-applicable members.
required_change: Restrict validation to the applicable local-frame population, including bottom local frames and transverse local frames in side structures, rather than all nltl:hasStructuralMember values.
regression_guard: Preserve the applicable local-member scope and do not broaden the rule to unrelated ship structural members.

problem: The candidate makes frameProfileType mandatory on the ship, but the cited I2.6.1 requirement contains no obligation to provide a frame profile type.
required_change: Remove the mandatory nltl:frameProfileType property constraint from this shape.
regression_guard: Preserve only semantic elements required by I2.6.1.

problem: The candidate makes a ship-level patchLoad quantity mandatory, although the requirement mandates the bottom-structure patch-load orientation, not a separate ship-level patch-load magnitude.
required_change: Remove the mandatory ship-level nltl:patchLoad constraint, or represent patch-load information only where needed to enforce the required bottom-structure orientation.
regression_guard: Preserve the bottom-structure patch orientation condition without inventing a mandatory ship-level load quantity.

problem: The plasticCollapseMechanism is required as an unrelated ship-level string and is not linked to the structural member's midspanPlasticCollapseLoad. Consequently, the candidate does not encode that plastic strength is the magnitude of the midspan load causing development of the plastic collapse mechanism; it only compares plasticStrength numerically with midspanPlasticCollapseLoad.
required_change: Remove the unrelated ship-level string constraint and add a member-scoped semantic relationship or equivalent executable constraint linking the midspan collapse load to development of the plastic collapse mechanism, while retaining plasticStrength = midspanPlasticCollapseLoad.
regression_guard: Preserve the plastic-strength definition and its member ownership/path; do not replace the required relationship with an unscoped text field.
